resources.string: The one gold strip. Tick it from the home screen; tap the title to open the task.
Taped gold card with the four-leaf clover. Its time, and the box.
Top 3 to tick, the goal on its paper strip first.
The date and the day’s progress, the paper goal, Up next as a block, the picks to tick.
The Now card, the next blocks, the paper goal, the Top 3 to tick, and a capture bar.
What’s running or up next in its colour, its progress, what comes after; Start focus or Done.
The next block in its calendar colour, its title on two lines.
Done count, the finish estimate, and the wisteria growing with it.
The seal with a word, for people who like labels.
Type, talk, or write on paper (opens Paper capture’s camera).
One tap to photograph handwritten notes.
Opens the chat with the question typed; the chip sends a starter.
Today’s column as the calendar draws it, from now on, with the now line. Tap a block to open it.
The week with today in lavender, then the day’s column. Tap a day to open the calendar there.
Seven days; up to three dots each. Today is the lavender chip.
Days until the next deadline or event you’re counting to.
Ring, minutes left, the task, Stop and Done. Idle: the coiled fern and Start on the goal.
A mini ring and the task while it runs.
The same with each routine’s last seven days as petals and sage.
One routine’s vine, at its real stage, with the goal.
The streak plant at 1 × 1 (resize the Streak plant to get it).
The hydrangea fills with the count. Sort them opens triage.
The count, the oldest, and Replan all.
What hasn’t been touched in a while, and for how long.
Mornings until the day is planned; evenings until it’s closed. One widget, two faces.
The journal’s line for today: write or say it.
A resurfaced note or line, once a day.
The season, read from your clock.
Today to tick: the paper goal, then the picks and today’s tasks. The + captures.
The whole Today: Next, the goal, the Top 3, Today’s tasks, Overdue and Also open, and a capture bar.
Up next with its progress line and times, and what comes after.
The calendar’s Now card, then the next two blocks in their colours.
The whole day in one bar, 7 AM to 11 PM, and Next. Tap the bar for today’s calendar.
The day bar, Next with its countdown, and the goal.
The day bar, Next, the goal, the Top 3 to tick, and a capture bar.
